## Main user workflows

### FLOW-GOVERNANCE-CHANGE — Governed Skill Workflow change

Change Skill Workflow source or governance state while preserving exact authority, deterministic documentation, blocking evidence, and roadmap synchronization.

Authority: SKILL.md plus current .workflow project truth and exact Git candidate

- BASELINED -> IMPLEMENTING : Make the minimum authorized source/spec change after authority and documentation impact are established.
- IMPLEMENTING -> VERIFYING : Run targeted tests, regenerate affected evidence/docs, and execute required governance validation.
- VERIFYING -> READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE : Require cumulative tests, exact-candidate governance gates, and explicit evidence boundaries.
- READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE -> ACCEPTED : Accept only the exact tested/documented HEAD with clean final provenance.
